Method of Attack: Ransomware targeting VMware ESXi servers using a new Linux locker
Partial file encryption based on file size
Generates ransom note 'readme.txt' in every directory
Terminates ESXi VMs using '-type=soft' parameter to evade detection
Modifies /etc/motd and index.html to display ransom note on login
Appends 'MONTI' byte signature and encryption key bytes to encrypted files
Indicators of Compromise: Modified /etc/motd and index.html files containing ransom note
Presence of 'MONTI' byte signature in encrypted files
